outcome.settling_measurement: Run one paired experiment on the WSL2 Ubuntu x86_64 host, holding Claude Code, model, prompts, language-server versions, repository and Serena configuration fixed. Compare Serena alone against Serena plus the matching F08 native plugin. Use sealed definition/reference questions and edits that introduce and then repair compiler-confirmed errors; include a multi-step refactor with temporary intermediate errors. Exercise both Claude Code Edit/Write and Serena's editing tools. Capture exact native navigation answers, whether diagnostics reaching the agent reflect each edited revision and clear after repair, final compiler results, startup/index-update latency, known-source read cost, tokens and peak RAM. Do not require unsolicited delivery as an additional acceptance condition. Choose A if the enabled arm reliably supplies the requested native navigation and current post-edit diagnostics beyond the control. Choose B if, after confirming correct installation and a healthy server, that addition is absent or persistently stale.

slots.question: Which single gateway routes GPT-6-family calls from Codex and SDK workers (account pooling, routing, usage observation, request compression off unless chosen), or none (the native clients call the provider directly)?

outcome.settling_measurement: Run one paired conformance evaluation on the specified WSL2 x86_64 host, with fixed client versions and the same verifiable tool-use tasks through native calls and OmniRoute v3.8.51's codex OAuth provider. Exercise Codex CLI, Codex SDK and an OpenAI-compatible worker across Astra/Sol/Luna and their supported efforts, including omitted effort and native Ultra configurations. Capture actual native requests first to establish which Lite header/metadata and parallel-tool combinations are supported; then compare their gateway upstream requests and task outcomes, including equivalent gateway suffix aliases. Keep compression off and Thinking Budget passthrough, with no model/effort override rules. Pool two native accounts, inject a first-account 429, and reconcile upstream completions against usage records during concurrent streaming: successful tokens must appear once, while a separate zero-token failure record is allowed. Record task success and paired latency. Choose B if the required lanes preserve supported native semantics and accounting while adding successful account failover; choose A if a supported native flow reproducibly loses requested semantics or the required failover, compression or accounting behavior fails.

slots.question: Which single runtime worker runs autonomous coding and research tasks in an isolated sandbox, driven by GPT-6.1 Sol through its harness SDK, or none (the native clients' own workers suffice)?

Which single tool converts difficult-layout documents (PDF, scans, Office formats, EPUB, HTML) into Markdown or JSON for ingestion, or none?

outcome.settling_measurement: Measure the paired difference in format-macro-averaged, structure-aware extraction error between F05 and F07 on one sealed corpus of difficult PDFs, scans, Office formats, EPUB and HTML, on the stated WSL2 Ubuntu/RTX 4090 host. Pin the packet source commits, resolved dependencies and model hashes. Run Docling's standard conversion and MinerU's automatic Standard-for-PDF/Flash-for-native routing through each client's CLI access, exporting native JSON. Before examining outputs, fix independent reference annotations and one canonical serialization preserving text, reading order and table row/cell/span structure. Score normalized edit distance on that serialization, assign maximum error to missing conversions, installation failures or resource failures, and weight the five document families equally. Use randomized repeated runs and a paired, document-level bootstrap confidence interval for E(Docling)-E(MinerU). An interval wholly below zero selects Docling; wholly above zero selects MinerU; overlap retains unsettled. Do not introduce a latency veto or an arbitrary percentage-improvement threshold.

outcome.settling_measurement: Run one paired full-log reconciliation benchmark on WSL2 Ubuntu x86_64 using F06 v0.4.1 and F07 v20.0.26 against the same frozen Claude Code and Codex corpus. Include completed tasks, logged failures and retries, streamed revisions, copied and archived sessions, forks, Claude advisor iterations, Codex per-response-only compaction, last_token_usage-only records and missing cache fields. Independently annotate unique provider responses, all four token classes, recoverable aggregate totals and genuinely unavailable fields; preserve the original logs and exclude artifact-size estimates. Compare F06 through its normal store and authenticated /api/console endpoint, not --summary, with F07’s agent-specific --json --offline reports. Use identical UTC windows and sufficient retention, wait for ingestion to finish, and isolate each agent’s corpus where necessary. Measure incorrectly reported or omitted known tokens by agent and class, plus false claims that unavailable quantities are known. Apply the same reconciliation rule to both; neither challenger nor incumbent must be flawless.
